title: Format a price banner
prompt:
A shop banner must be printed with formatted numbers. Inside `main`, print exactly:

```
=== WEEKLY DEAL ===
Price: 19.99 USD
=== END ===
```

Use `String.formatted` (or printf) so the price comes from a `double price = 19.991;` variable and is rounded to 2 decimal places.

tests.name: banner shape
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.main(new String[0]));
CjTestBase.checkLines(out, "=== WEEKLY DEAL ===", "Price: 19.99 USD", "=== END ===");
tests.hint: The price line must show 19.99 (two decimals), not 19.991.
